label: animals
name: Animals Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR animal image into one or more detailed categories based on the animal type, domestication, habitat, and visible biological group.

labels.pet: A photo primarily showing a domesticated animal kept as a household companion, such as a dog, cat, rabbit, or hamster.
labels.bird: A photo primarily showing one or more birds, including flying, perched, swimming, or domestic birds.
labels.fish: A photo primarily showing one or more fish in an aquarium, river, lake, ocean, or other aquatic environment.
labels.reptile: A photo primarily showing reptiles such as snakes, lizards, turtles, tortoises, crocodiles, or alligators.
labels.amphibian: A photo primarily showing amphibians such as frogs, toads, salamanders, or newts.
labels.insect: A photo primarily showing insects such as butterflies, bees, ants, beetles, flies, or grasshoppers.
labels.wildlife: A photo primarily showing wild animals living in a natural habitat, such as lions, elephants, deer, bears, or monkeys.
labels.farm_animal: A photo primarily showing domesticated animals commonly raised on farms, such as cattle, goats, sheep, pigs, horses, or chickens.
